definitions.explanation: The set of implements used in the Japanese tea ceremony, including the tea bowl, whisk, scoop, and other items.

examples.japanese: {茶道具|さどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{茶道具|さどうぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧ものだ。
examples.english: These tea utensils were passed down from my grandmother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{茶道具|さどうぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw an exhibition of Edo-period tea utensils at the art museum.

notes:
Compound of {茶|さ} (tea, in its on'yomi reading used in ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧) and ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ (tools, utensils). Refers collectively to the implements used in ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (tea ceremony).

KEY ITEMS:
- ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧: tea bowl
- ⟦{茶筅|ちゃせん}→茶筅：23829_chasen⟧: bamboo whisk
- ⟦{茶杓|ちゃしゃく}→茶杓：23830_chashaku⟧: tea scoop
- {棗|なつめ}: thin tea container
- ⟦{水差|みずさ}し→水差し：22287_mizusashi⟧: water jar
- ⟦{柄杓|ひしゃく}→柄杓：25493_hishaku⟧: ladle
- ⟦{釜|かま}→釜：03880_kama⟧: kettle

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶道具|さどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to gather tea utensils
- {茶道具|さどうぐ}{一式|いっしき}: a full set of tea utensils
- {茶道具|さどうぐ}{屋|や}: tea utensil shop
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{茶道具|さどうぐ}: antique tea utensils

CULTURAL NOTE:
Fine {茶道具|さどうぐ} are valued as art objects and can be extremely expensive. Famous pieces are given individual names and have documented histories spanning centuries.
